notes.title: Discord - Join us and invite your friends!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35990107/86b74f43b90b9d252228247de12df4fce47e9056.jpg
We created a discord server, where you can:
- discuss the development of Magicians Legacy 😃
- suggest ideas to improve the game or criticize 👍
- discuss another games you like 😍
- just chat and get all the information directly from the developers! 😎

Join us and invite your friends!
